capabilities_done: slice 1: open (package -> folio snapshot), revision-checked submit through an instance-owned provider registry, atomic save with destination re-read, cancellation + budgets, one Observe frame per operation, session-consumer
slice 2: injected GrantPort/CommitPort/JobPort/Clock, idempotency keys + canonical receipts, outcome-unknown reconcile (exactly once), bounded admission, shutdown drain, export_checkpoint

slice 3 lazy source (src/source.rs): open keeps the package as a Read+Seek stream behind PackageReader (structure and every entry checksum verified in bounded 1 MiB chunks); the document and the entries that must be preserved verbatim (opaque, unlisted) are read through a second logical cursor over the same stream and verified against the manifest SHA-256; asset and preview bodies are NOT read at open (tile digests are checked against the manifest only). Resident at rest: document, preserved unknown entries, host-supplied previews

slice 3 on-demand reads: save/export pull each asset from the source one at a time (PackageReader::read_asset, SHA-256 verified, bounded by the writer's max and the manifest's declared size) and source previews lazily; the real cause of a failed read (hash_mismatch, io, canceled) is reported instead of asset_absent; the written file becomes the new source (old handle released) and in-memory sessions (open_bytes) release their copy on first save

slice 3 host previews: Session::set_previews(rendered_for_revision, Vec<PreviewImage>) validates (dimensions, byte length, colour tag, unique content, <= MAX_SUPPLIED_PREVIEWS, total bytes) and accepts only the current revision (stale_revision otherwise); supplied previews replace the source's at the next save/export at that revision; anything rendered for another revision is dropped and counted (SaveReceipt/Checkpoint.previews_dropped); supplied previews are released once written. PixelFormat/PreviewImage/PreviewInfo re-exported so hosts need no package dependency

R3 lineage (63c1f5d): propose_checked now requires the provider's successor to equal the live document plus new values at exactly the declared revision-update addresses (mask_property on both documents, compare, revision aligned); a provider that prepared from an edited copy is refused with SessionError::ProposalNotDerived (code proposal_not_derived, Observe Failure(Validation)) before publish or any commit-port call

streaming save (943a0d2): LazyAssets implements package AssetStream (raw entries stream from their byte range in the source through a forked Handle cursor, constant memory; zstd/shuffle_zstd entries decode via PackageReader::read_asset as one blob; open is repeatable, one reader at a time; the real cause is kept in take_failure); save_inner uses save_atomic_streaming (package re-verifies the temp from disk before the atomic replace), gather_previews/write_options/writer_cause shared with export; export_checkpoint stays on write_package_with (a Checkpoint is an in-memory verified package by contract); the destination is still reopened as the new source (Handle::pair, new raw cursor)

api_compat: kernel-bindings compatibility: slice 3 is additive only. No signature, field or enum variant of the slice-1/2 public API changed (SessionPorts, SessionConfig, Session::open_path/open_bytes/submit/submit_keyed/reconcile/drain/save/save_to/export_checkpoint, Applied, SaveReceipt, Checkpoint, SessionError, the port traits). kernel-bindings checks clean against it.
added: Session::set_previews, Session::source_bytes_read, Session::resident_bytes, PreviewReceipt, MAX_SUPPLIED_PREVIEWS, re-exports PixelFormat/PreviewImage/PreviewInfo

behaviour notes: open_bytes copies the given bytes (the lazy source must own them); SaveReceipt/Checkpoint.previews_dropped now also counts source previews replaced by host-supplied ones; a package with a corrupted asset now fails at save/export (hash_mismatch) rather than at open, because assets are no longer read at open (the whole archive is still CRC-verified at open)

R3: one additive SessionError variant, ProposalNotDerived (code proposal_not_derived, outcome Failure(Validation)); no existing signature, field or variant changed. kernel-bindings and harness do not match on SessionError (they use Failed::code) and check clean. LazyAssets/Handle are crate-private (Handle::single removed, Handle::fork added); SaveReceipt/Checkpoint unchanged.
decisions: Lazy open is built from package's public API only (PackageReader + EntryMeta data offsets + a second cursor over one shared stream); package has no lazy into_opened, so the document/opaque/unlisted classification and tile-digest-vs-manifest check mirror package's into_opened strictness in src/source.rs
Previews are written only when they describe the revision being written; host-supplied previews are accepted only for the current revision
Grant action for set_previews is Action::Save (a new Action variant would break exhaustive matches in kernel-bindings)
No new SessionError variants: stale previews reuse StaleRevision, invalid previews reuse Package(PreviewMismatch)/TooManyEntries/TotalTooLarge

R3: supersedes 'No new SessionError variants' - a distinct code (proposal_not_derived) for a successor that is not the live document plus the declared writes, so callers can tell it from proposal_inconsistent (wrong document or revision)

R3: lineage is checked in the session (not delegated to the provider): both documents are compared with the declared revision-update properties neutralised; chronicle's property table is mirrored locally (mask_property) because chronicle keeps value/set private

Streaming save keeps the post-save destination reopen: it is how the written file becomes the new lazy source; the package already re-verified the temp, so the manifest document_id/revision check there is a cheap second guard
known_gaps: open is O(file) in I/O: PackageReader::open CRC-verifies every entry (bounded memory); no way to skip it with the current package API
post-save verification (VerifyMismatch) leaves the newly written file in place and does not advance saved_revision
idempotency table is in memory only; the authority's receipt store is the durable one
cancel-acknowledgement bound is not separately timed (operations are synchronous, cancel is polled at entry, in provider/read loops and before commit)
resolver in session-consumer grants everything: example stand-in only

streaming-save item now MET (943a0d2): save peak is size-independent. Still true: export_checkpoint buffers the whole package (in-memory Checkpoint by contract), and a zstd or shuffle_zstd asset buffers one blob (about 3-4x the blob) during save

r3_remediation.finding: propose_checked never verified the successor derives from the current snapshot (session.rs 862-900): a provider that prepared from an edited copy (same id and revision) published an unrevisioned change and the inverse could not undo it

r3_remediation.also: coordinator addition: streaming save migrated onto package save_atomic_streaming (943a0d2); the 'not constant-memory' known gap is met, measured peak 1.3 MiB at 1 MiB and 16 MiB assets
r3_remediation.compat: kernel-bindings and harness: cargo check --tests --examples clean against both commits
r3_remediation.lesson: match on a non-Copy enum field behind a reference needs a reference scrutinee (E0507: use match (&address.target.node_kind, ...)); recorded here, not as a shared-gameplan step (lead rule: product compile/test mistakes go in lane notes; a fixing commit clears the retry guard)
